# Navo Premium | Barbearia & Club

Navo Premium is a modern barber shop and club management application built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Express, and PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM).

## Key Features
- Online Booking System (Step-by-step: Services -> Barbers -> Date/Time -> Review -> Confirmation)
- Client Appointments Management & Lookup (via phone number + verification code)
- Subscriptions & Loyalty Programs (Points, rewards, Instagram check-in, referral system)
- Admin Dashboard (Financial management, cash transactions, schedule blocks, client management, WhatsApp reminders integration)
- PWA Support & Responsive Mobile-First UI
